app-15100.reason: This game takes no controller on PC without a third-party fix (its Options list only keyboard layouts), so its on-screen controls start as a keyboard and mouse.

app-1168280.reason: Its compute shaders use double-precision instructions. DXMT runs them in single precision (decision 0206); DXVK refuses them on KosmicKrisp, which has no 64-bit floats, so the game stops at createComputeShader on Vulkan.

app-1174180.reason: This game draws through Vulkan or Direct3D 12, which only the Vulkan layer runs, so it keeps Vulkan even when Settings chooses DXMT for every game. It is told 2,304 MB of video memory, not 3,072: it sizes its texture streaming from that figure, and Story's first load otherwise passes the app's memory limit.

app-3013550.reason: Its emulated games' sound wavers in pitch. It is told its monitor runs at 60 Hz, the rate its frames are limited to, rather than the panel's 120 Hz, and its audio streams report their delivery and underruns (decision 0207).

app-292030.reason: The current build reserves 64 GB and 32 GB of address space at start, more than an iPhone app has, so it gets the first 6 GB of each and is told it got all of it.

bnet-wow.reason: The game's x86-64 client runs without AVX and takes its SSE paths: its start handles many exceptions, and the emulator does not keep the AVX registers' upper halves in an exception's context, so AVX code could resume with wrong values.
